title: Neon Jester on Pier
description: A man in a flamboyant blue and gold jester-like costume with glowing blue orbs on his shoulders and chest crouches dynamically on a pier. Behind him stand five silhouetted figures in top hats against a dramatic fiery orange and red sunset sky over water, with glowing blue spiked orbs scattered across the wet ground.
prompt: A dynamic male figure in an elaborate blue, gold and red jester costume with glowing blue spherical shoulder pads and chest piece, crouching on a wooden pier at sunset. His outfit has intricate patterns and a flowing cape. Five mysterious silhouetted men wearing top hats stand in a row behind him on the pier. Glowing blue spiked orbs with neon symbols are scattered across the wet reflective ground. Dramatic fiery orange and red sky with swirling clouds, cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
